notes: Version 2.3 adds the EffComp working paper (10.5281/zenodo.21729274) to Branch I and names the transversal contract K4: admissibility to composable effective subsystems. Independence blocks are exactly the bicliques of the projected support relation; on a block the full simplex lifts every product preparation; strictly positive cylindrical conditionings are product-closed iff the fibre-weight matrix has rank one; support rectangularity does not imply preparation independence. The contract is proposed, not derived from A1-A4. The graph gains the EffComp node and typed edges: Foundation to EffComp postulated; EffComp to Q3 and to ENT-Note interpretive, marking consumers of a supplied composition structure.
